items.text: the words list sorts by sequence, A to Z, or your own order (drag the handle); the sequence plays in the order shown
"same size": every word in the sequence is set at one size, the one that fits the longest word or line
LOOP, SWIM and PLAY are in the list from the start, ready to play
the add row reads "add word…", with + at its right
on a computer, a pin at the foot of the index: pinned it stays open; unpinned, a click on the stage closes it
the CHAMY·XYZ mark stays at the foot of the index with a close button; the version and copyright open under it at the end of the index, or with a click on the mark
install and index shortcuts in the bottom corners of the launch screen
a live microphone now shows as "mic" under the sound button, like "video" under capture, instead of a red dot that read as recording
"start here" no longer shows over the index: it waits while the index is open, sits under it, and stays away after a link like #install
"check for updates" in the install section answers again: you have the newest, or a newer version is ready
"What's new" in the update notice: see what a new version brings before you update
the version number and this version's notes under Version in the index
opening a link like #install on an iPhone no longer leaves the stage black and the buttons dead
the G-code engine is now part of the shared kit, ready to move other things along a toolpath
a link like #install now waits for the launch cover instead of opening under it
